title: Flight Itinerary Route Planner
spec: Implement a route planning algorithm for connecting flights. The planner must ensure that the maximum flight distance per leg does not exceed 4096 miles, and the total combined route distance is capped at 65535 miles. The maximum layover time permitted between flights is 256 minutes. The itinerary can contain at most 16 intermediate stops, and group bookings are limited to 32 passengers. The seating preference score must be scaled and clamped to 255. Enforce baggage weight limits of exactly 64 lbs or 128 lbs depending on the tier, and limit the total number of route combinations evaluated to 1024.

title: Real Estate Valuation Engine
spec: Create a property valuation calculator using real estate metrics. The engine must reject properties with a lot size exceeding 65535 square meters. Use a baseline home size of 1024 square feet for the initial estimate. The maximum distance to public transit considered is 4096 meters. Cap the property age depreciation penalty at 255 months. Local amenities increase value up to a count of 64, with a special premium if the count exceeds 128. The maximum number of floor levels considered for high-rises is 16. Ensure that exactly 32 similar comparable properties are retrieved, and cap the historical records parsed at 256.

title: Bioinformatics PCR Primer Designer
spec: Write a small module to analyze DNA sequences for PCR primer design. The total sequence length to be analyzed must be capped at 65535 base pairs. The target primer length must be strictly checked to be between 16 and 32 bases. The maximum GC content score allowed is 255. Ensure the distance between forward and reverse primers is at least 128 and at most 1024 bases. The penalty score for hairpin formations is clamped at a maximum of 64. Use a default scanning buffer window of 4096 bases, and limit the maximum number of iterations for the cross-dimer check to 256.

title: Fitness Tracker Data Synchronizer
spec: Design a synchronization module for fitness tracker wearable data. Limit the step count per sync interval to a maximum of 65535. Enforce a minimum heart rate baseline of 128 and clamp the maximum heart rate recorded to 255. The data block size for sleep cycles must be exactly 1024 bytes. Pre-allocate a buffer of 4096 bytes for chunking GPS coordinates. The user is limited to 16 distinct activity types. Syncing is only allowed if the battery level is above 32 percent. The app must only sync a maximum of 64 offline days, and the connection should timeout if no data is received within 256 seconds.

title: Warehouse Inventory Barcode Generator
spec: Develop a barcode parameters generator for warehouse inventory items. The system must process an item array and halt if the total items exceed 65535. Divide the items into processing batches of exactly 1024. The output barcode image width must be constrained to 256 pixels, and the quiet zone margin must be exactly 16 pixels. The height of the bars should be set to either 32 or 64 pixels based on the density setting. Calculate a checksum string by applying modulo 128 to the item identifier. The printer's DPI limit setting must be capped at 255, and the maximum metadata payload size per barcode is 4096 bytes.
